crossRefs.note: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

parallels.note: He lit the lamps before Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof so as to give light in front of the candlestick, as Jehovah commanded Moses.
